notes: Graphs/*.vscript are the gameplay sources; Scripts/Generated/*.as are compiled from them and checked in so the module runs without a graph-compilation step. VisualScriptGraphs_CheckedInGraphsRegenerateShippedScripts fails when a script no longer matches its graph. After editing a graph, regenerate the scripts (see README.md) and update the SHA-256 values here in the same change. Audio/VisualScript/*.wav are the playSound() cues, regenerated by tools/audio/compose_visualscript_cues.py; update their SHA-256 values here when that script changes.
